recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the approved source application without reintroducing the rejected simple-subset restriction; any future validation tooling or FHIRPath profile policy should come from separate ballot feedback or work-group action.
issue_request: FHIR-51587 asked that FHIRPath used in the core spec be validated. Its final Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution added SearchParameter expression guidance about resolve(), resource-boundary traversal, and ballot feedback rather than imposing a simple-subset restriction.
initial_application: Commit 6447bc19d39c37d98b235b97a1f455205d94e9cb added the SearchParameter notes section and ballot note, but did not add the requested SearchParameter.expression element comment. The notes also retained examples using the invalid FHIRPath function spelling descendents.
additional_context: The Zulip origin thread identified an invalid core SearchParameter expression and concern over resolve() bypassing chaining. FHIR-I minutes on 2025-11-03 reopened the earlier simple-subset resolution because it conflicted with FHIR-49784, which required repeat() in search expressions, and approved guidance plus ballot input instead of a normative subset ban.
reconciliation: Updated source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml so SearchParameter.expression carries the approved resolve()/resource-boundary guidance. Updated source/searchparameter/searchparameter-notes.xml to use the valid FHIRPath Resource.descendants().extension(...) examples.
